file_reviews.review: Complete and chunked Harmony parsing checks reasoning/content/tool separation; four token-count checks need a distinct counting unit.
Parser-composition tests assert emitted reasoning, content, tool calls and tool-choice fallback under fixed chunks; they do not inspect constraint schemas.
Complete parser and prompt-boundary checks assert reasoning/content/tool fields; one history-count helper has a different target.
Fixed marker and token-ID cases assert reasoning/content split and end-state transitions, including split markers.
JSON tool-parser tests assert call name, arguments, fallback and chunk invariance; registry alias check is not parser behavior.
Plamo parser cases compare complete versus streamed reasoning/content/tool fields and partial marker behavior.
Non-thinking and thinking cases assert extracted content and tool calls; standalone newline normalizer and registry checks need different units.
One entry compares complete token IDs; other entries compare rendered prompt text or configuration without token-ID oracle.
All sampled entries inspect rendered text, configuration, or exceptions rather than a reference token-ID sequence.
Two entries check actual media UUID/payload order or absence; remaining entries predominantly inspect prompt text and need a rendering unit.
